
if(ARM64EC_RUNTIME)
    if(NOT ARM64EC_NATIVE_BINARY_DIR OR
       NOT EXISTS "${ARM64EC_NATIVE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/include/asm/ksarm64.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "ARM64EC_RUNTIME requires the primary ARM64 ksarm64.h in ARM64EC_NATIVE_BINARY_DIR")
    endif()

    # Kernel structure offsets belong to the native ARM64 system, not to the
    # x64-compatible ARM64EC user ABI. Reuse the header generated by the
    # primary build instead of compiling the kernel-layout generator as EC.
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ksarm64.h"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${ARM64EC_NATIVE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/include/asm/ksarm64.h"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ksarm64.h"
        DEPENDS "${ARM64EC_NATIVE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/include/asm/ksarm64.h"
        VERBATIM)
    add_custom_target(asm DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ksarm64.h")
    return()
endif()

add_library(genincdata MODULE genincdata.c)
target_compile_definitions(genincdata PRIVATE NTDDI_VERSION=${REACTOS_TARGET_NTDDI})

set_entrypoint(genincdata 0)
add_dependencies(genincdata bugcodes psdk xdk)

if(MSVC)
    set(OPT_MS "-ms")
else()
    set(OPT_MS "")
endif()

if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    set(_filename ks386.inc)
elseif(ARCH STREQUAL "amd64")
    set(_filename ksamd64.inc)
elseif(ARCH STREQUAL "arm")
    set(_filename ksarm.h)
elseif(ARCH STREQUAL "arm64")
    set(_filename ksarm64.h)
endif()

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${_filename}
    COMMAND native-geninc $<TARGET_FILE:genincdata> ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${_filename} ${OPT_MS}
    DEPENDS genincdata native-geninc)

add_custom_target(asm
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${_filename})
